items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: with Russ Garcia doing the arranging for me on that album

ctx.x: Loyal. Well, I'm very grateful for that, Pat. Through the years the people that were devoted fans, they still are, and I guess, like many people have asked me

today why I'm not -- they don't hear more of me. Well, the answer is, you know, I've been with several record companies. Capitol, of course, was my first company. And then I was with Decca awhile and I was with Columbia, and I did some things for Imperial and one of the things that I did was on Liberty. I did an album on Liberty which I consider a very, very good album, with Russ Garcia doing the arranging for me on that album, and he did a marvelous job. It's a marvelous album. It was one of the -- one of the…

But I was glad to -- it gave me a chance to really display some versatility, you know, because I could perform as a single artist or with -- when I say single I mean with rhythm and piano, and/or with a big orchestra. That was -- but the arrangements were built around me and for me, and I give -- really, I give both of these men credit. Harold Mooney on
